title: Step along a direction
prompt: Something at position moves step units along direction, which already has length 1. Return the new position.
signature: func solve(position: Vector2, direction: Vector2, step: float) -> Vector2:
starter:
func solve(position: Vector2, direction: Vector2, step: float) -> Vector2:
	return position
hint: Scale the direction by the step, then add it to the position.
solution:
func solve(position: Vector2, direction: Vector2, step: float) -> Vector2:
	return position + direction * step
